title: Your experience. A clearer next step.
subtitle: ATS Coach AI
narration: Your experience deserves a clear introduction. ATS Coach AI helps you understand how your background fits a role, prepare your application, and practice the conversation. Explore the complete workflow with an interactive sample.

title: One application workspace
subtitle: A connected path through preparation
narration: Bring a resume and a target job. Review the evidence behind the match, edit your resume and cover letter, prepare application answers, and practice interviews. Each step keeps your own experience at the center.

title: The evidence behind the match
subtitle: Exact evidence, related experience, and gaps
narration: The diagnosis explains what your resume supports. Separate exact matches from related experience and missing requirements. Use the educational score as a starting point for review. It does not predict a hiring decision.

title: Documents you can make your own
subtitle: Direct editing with fonts, spacing, and PDF review
narration: Click into the document canvas to edit your text. Adjust the font, spacing, and margins, then review the PDF. A matching cover letter gives you another starting point that you can revise in your own voice.

title: Application answers with evidence
subtitle: A suggestion you can inspect and revise
narration: Prepare answers using your saved materials. Type a question or dictate it, then review a grounded suggestion and its supporting evidence. Unsupported details prompt a request for information instead of invented experience.

title: Interview practice with text and voice
subtitle: Spoken questions and editable answer transcripts
narration: Hear a question through your speakers. Respond by typing or speaking into your microphone, then review the transcript before submitting. Live practice adds feedback and follow-up questions, with your latest application materials as context.

title: Useful for individual and guided preparation
subtitle: Job seekers, coaches, universities, and client demos
narration: Job seekers can prepare independently. Coaches and university programs can guide a review using the same explained workflow. Save the application workspace locally, download the files you approve, and keep a separate set for each role.

title: Thank you
subtitle: Try the interactive sample
narration: See how the workflow fits your next application. Open ATS Coach AI and choose Explore the interactive sample. Use the walkthrough whenever you need help. You review the facts and choose what to share. Thank you.
